title: Grapher topic render catalogue (frontend-owned)
description: Per-topic per-indicator render hints, owned by the frontend per ADR-0045. One row per (topic_id, indicator_id) pair. Carries the chart_type and dimension overrides that previously lived inline on topic-catalogue artifact entries. Rows are optional; absence == frontend defaults from indicator_render.json.

x-changelog.description: Initial grapher topic render catalogue per ADR-0045 (grapher catalogue split). Replaces inline chart_type + dimension on topic-catalogue artifact entries. PR-A3b migrates readers; PR-A3c strips the fields from topic-catalogue.schema.json.

U4 (chart-type switcher seam). Additive: (a) new optional `chart_types` array carrying the per-topic per-indicator feasible chart-type list; reader prefers `chart_types[0]` over the singular `chart_type` (ADR-0047 reader-before-writer); (b) widen both `chart_type` (singular, deprecated alias) and `chart_types[]` enum to the full 12-member ChartType set documented in docs/reference/chart-index.md section 1, plus the deprecated `stacked-trend` literal retained for back-compat reading.

chart_type.description: DEPRECATED in v1.1 (use `chart_types`). Singular per-topic chart-type override; reader prefers `chart_types[0]` when both are present.

chart_types.description: Ordered per-topic per-indicator feasible chart-type list. `chart_types[0]` is the on-load default; subsequent entries are additional switcher segments. Added in v1.1 per plan section 16.3a + 21.9 (U4).

dimension.description: Facet axis name for this card on this topic page (e.g. 'power_source').
